model_annotation: The image displays Figure 4, which consists of two grouped bar charts comparing the distribution of one-level semantic domains for verbs across four different corpora: news, traditional literature, online novels, and microblog. The charts are titled "(a) Distribution of one-level semantic domains for auxiliary verbs in each corpus" and "(b) Distribution of one-level semantic domains for passive verbs in each corpus." Both charts use a vertical bar format, with the y-axis representing frequency, labeled "频次," and ranging from 0 to 7000 in increments of 1000. The x-axis represents the four corpora, arranged in the order: news, traditional literature, online novels, and microblog. Each bar is segmented to show the frequency of different semantic domains, with a legend on the right side of each chart detailing the specific domains and their corresponding colors. The bars are grouped by corpus, with each group containing four bars representing the four semantic domains. The bars are sorted in descending order of total frequency for each corpus. The highest frequency in chart (a) is 6738 for the "social" domain in microblog, while the highest in chart (b) is 6538 for the "work" domain in microblog. The shortest bars are for the "travel" domain in news (19) and the "work" domain in traditional literature (0). The data labels on top of each bar segment show the frequency and the percentage of the total for that corpus.
